Après une visite, les informations peuve: After a visit, information can remain in separate notes, photos and messages. A tool can consolidate them and prepare a structured report. The person who performed the intervention shall retain the validation of the facts, reservations and actions proposed to the client.
Après validation, conservez la version t: After validation, keep the transmitted version and distinguish between internal tasks and client reporting. Test an incomplete draft, a correction after validation and photos from another folder. A new version must maintain its relationship with the previous one. The tracking may create a reminder action, but should not automatically issue a quote or invoice from an unverified note.
Exemple illustratif : après une visite p: Example: After a preparatory visit, a team notes an access to check and adds photos. The tool offers a report with a "points to be confirmed" section. The maintainer corrects the text and creates a reminder task. No sentence presents the performance as realized.
La synthèse ne remplace pas le jugement: The summary does not replace the judgment of the intervener or a specialized document required for a performance. Examples are organizational. No diagnosis, certificate of conformity or technical result shall be added if the sources do not permit it.
La trame distingue ce qui était prévu, c: The frame distinguishes what was planned, what was observed, what was achieved and what remained to be done. Each attachment is attached to the file concerned. A photo must not become evidence of work not described by the intervener. Provide fields to report uncertainty or missing information, rather than requiring a full text in all cases.
L’IA peut reformuler les notes et propos: L的IA may redraft notes and propose a readable organization, but it must not deduct an absent diagnosis or report an operation completed. Present the draft next to the source elements. The reservations and actions to be confirmed remain visible. An ambiguous sentence should be clarified by the intervener before any transmission, particularly when it could be understood as a technical or commercial undertaking.
